{{Top|leg}}
The '''three warrior statues''' were created by a [[Unidentified military commander|military commander]] of an [[Unidentified species (Unknown Regions)|alien species]]. They were made from dense wood and covered in precious metals and gems. [[Yarkora/Legends|Yarkora]] antiquities dealer [[Saell-Terae]] once possessed these statues and hid them into a landing pontoon of his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], ''[[Lost Reef]]''. The statues were also wanted by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], who was in war with their creator and was seeking knowledge of his enemy.
